name: Orion by Gravity
description: Orion works 24/7, analyzing trends, uncovering opportunities, and teeing up your next move before you even log in. Your data is only telling half the story. Orion connects your business metrics with external data sources.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Orion by Gravity to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Orion by Gravity to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://g.runorion.com/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Orion by Gravity MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Orion by Gravity lists 21 MCP tools, including list_projects, list_conversations, get_conversation_history, list_artifacts, get_artifact, search_wiki, list_users, list_metrics, get_metric, get_metric_results, get_metric_insights, and list_workflows.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Orion by Gravity?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 18, 2026, alternatives to Orion by Gravity in data on the Manufact MCP catalog include Aura, Clarivate IPOne CompuMark Trademarks, Enterpret, Motion Creative Analytics, and Nimble.

_published_faq.name: Does Orion by Gravity MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: Orion by Gravity requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Orion by Gravity is developed by Gravity. It is listed as partner on the Claude connector directory.
